clues: This city in the far north of China sits on the Yellow River. The Gobi and Ordos deserts lie on each side of it.
Dry air here makes days and nights feel far apart in heat. Winters are cold and dry, and spring can bring dust storms.
In 1976, two towns on far banks of the river joined to make one city. It has held both banks since that year.
Huang Jianxiang was born here. He is a famed voice for football games on TV in China.
If you dug straight through Earth from here, you would come up in a city in Chile. Very few cities have such a match.
